timeline_authority: existing annotation and contiguous mask filenames at 5 FPS
rgb_matching: relative presentation timestamps rounded to the 5 FPS mask grid; reject nonmonotonic/off-grid PTS; explicit absent frames for gaps
extra_rgb_tail: decode and count, exclude unannotated tail from inputs
missing_rgb_tail: retain GT mask frame for tail or PTS gap, zero visual vector, explicit availability=false
nonzero_mask_id_without_object_label: exclude region from object input, log ID/frame/pixel counts, never infer class
known_track_masks: equality to object_id from annotation, matching the upstream relation GT-tube reader
spatial_geometry: normalized box center/width/height/area and mask area; exclusive right/bottom pixel edges
motion: difference of first four geometry channels divided by elapsed annotation frames between valid observations
